author: Pollo1998
quote:
STORY: is a 3 instead of a uClyde and Bonnie esc like they promised we got sims dating 
GRAPHICS: The graphics are better than gta 5 with more details and better lighting but all that goes away when you start playing it feels like you are playing pubg on a 2015 android during action scenes 
GAMEPLAY: they worried so much about making the game realistic they forgot that the gameplay experience makes or breaks a game the whole game is full of mundane boring tasks the story line included,  pair that with exciting parts of the story running at 15fps it makes the game unenjoyable and to a lot unplayable 
IMMERSION:the map is big but its big for no reason who cares if it takes 35 mins to go from end to end if everything feels slow and boring the world is full of npcs but that’s exactly what they feel like npcs just there taking up space 
FINAL THOUGHTS: the game is soulless boring and slow, even if it had 60 fps that would only fix a tenth of the problems this game has.
ITS NOT GTA  gta is a game that is about going from rags to riches, a game that might have some political ideologies but where it doesn’t force / try to train the player to abide and take up these ideologies. GTA is a game where you do what u want whenever u want that can be a law abiding citizen that follows traffic laws to a master business man with a criminal enterprise making millions.
